LanguageData.Gun_G36C_RWP.description: The G36C is a compact, lightweight assault rifle known for its reliability and accuracy. Ideal for close to mid-range combat, it uses 5.56mm ammunition and features a high rate of fire, making it effective in various combat scenarios. Its modular design allows for the attachment of scopes and other tactical accessories.
